newsitem.title: JAPAN: Many creditors positive on Tobishima plan - Fuji.
newsitem.headline: Many creditors positive on Tobishima plan - Fuji.

text.p: Fuji Bank Ltd, the main creditor bank for debt-ridden Tobishima Corp, said on Monday that many of the construction firm's creditor financial institutions had responded positively to its restructuring programme.

Many of the creditors were actively considering accepting the plan, a Fuji Bank spokesman said. But they have not reached a formal agreement yet on whether or not to accept the plan, the spokesman said.
Fuji, which itself has expressed support for Tobishima's plan, said that it was making strong efforts to gain their acceptance of the plan by the end of this month, the spokesman said.
There are about 50 creditors, including banks and life insurance companies, the Fuji spokesman said.
A Tobishima spokesman said that the company believed its creditors were in the final stage of their discussions and that they would accept the plan.

Tobishima drew up the restructuring plan last October in order to resolve its financial difficulties. Under the plan, its creditors would be asked to reduce their claims against Tobishima for debts owed by its group companies to 100 billion yen from about 740 billion yen.
Japanese daily Sankei Shimbun said on Saturday that the creditors would eventually accept the restructuring plan and an agreement was likely in April.
